#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qemu-system-arm busybox-static cpio gzip zstd python3
usermod -aG kvm johansardar
install -d -m 755 /opt/lamp-la/rootfs/{bin,dev,proc,sys}
cp /bin/busybox /opt/lamp-la/rootfs/bin/busybox
ln -sf busybox /opt/lamp-la/rootfs/bin/sh
cat > /opt/lamp-la/rootfs/init <<'INIT'
#!/bin/sh
/bin/busybox mount -t proc proc /proc
/bin/busybox mount -t sysfs sysfs /sys
echo LAMP_LA_NESTED_KVM_BOOT_OK
/bin/busybox uname -a
/bin/busybox cat /proc/cpuinfo
/bin/busybox poweroff -f
INIT
chmod 755 /opt/lamp-la/rootfs/init
cd /opt/lamp-la/rootfs
find . -print0 | cpio --null -o --format=newc | gzip -9 > /opt/lamp-la/initramfs.cpio.gz
kernel=$(readlink -f /boot/vmlinuz)
python3 - "$kernel" /opt/lamp-la/Image <<'PYTHON'
import gzip
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
image = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()
# Ubuntu 26.04 ships a UKI; extract its embedded Linux EFI zboot image.
if image[:2] == b'MZ' and image[4:8] != b'zimg':
    pe = struct.unpack_from('<I', image, 60)[0]
    count = struct.unpack_from('<H', image, pe + 6)[0]
    optional_size = struct.unpack_from('<H', image, pe + 20)[0]
    for i in range(count):
        section = pe + 24 + optional_size + i * 40
        name, size, _, _, offset = struct.unpack_from('<8sIIII', image, section)
        if name.rstrip(b'\0') == b'.linux':
            image = image[offset:offset + size]
            break
if image[4:8] == b'zimg':
    offset, size = struct.unpack_from('<II', image, 8)
    compression = image[24:32].split(b'\0')[0]
    if compression != b'zstd':
        raise RuntimeError(f'Unsupported EFI zboot compression: {compression!r}')
    image = subprocess.run(['zstd', '-dc'], input=image[offset:offset + size],
                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, check=True).stdout
elif image[:2] == b'\x1f\x8b':
    image = gzip.decompress(image)
if image[56:60] != b'ARMd':
    raise RuntimeError('Expected a raw ARM64 Linux Image header')
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_bytes(image)
PYTHON
chmod 644 /opt/lamp-la/Image /opt/lamp-la/initramfs.cpio.gz
printf '%s\n' "$kernel" > /opt/lamp-la/kernel-source
